member_index_policy.scope: Existing eight family memberships and strict three-member Gulf Stream System convention; no new identities or aliases.

source_reviews.review_mode: Primary publisher abstract inspected directly: regional deployment, averaging frame and deep-level presence. No full-method review, PDF pixels, figure digitization or new field processing claimed.

references.geographic_scope: Gulf Stream near 68W; regional SYNOP array, without an exact latitude or current-axis position assigned.
references.temporal_scope: June 1988–August 1990 array deployment; stream-coordinate mean, not a seasonal or instantaneous section.
references.source_definition: Deep downstream extension reported at 3500 m. Presence at this level supports an inclusive minimum reach, not a located lower boundary.
references.source_citation: Johns, Shay, Bane and Watts (1995), J.Geophys.Res.100(C1):817–838, doi:10.1029/94JC02497.
references.source_locator: Primary publisher abstract: deployment and stream-coordinate method in opening sentences; deep extension in results paragraph.
references.qualification: Local reach only. The 130 km width and 3–4 cm/s speeds describe the deep extension at 3500 m, not a surface or whole-current width. No detected bottom, continuous filled layer, uniform thickness, annual envelope, independent repeat, cross-sectional area or volume is established. Stream-coordinate averaging differs from a fixed Eulerian mean; adjacent westward recirculations are separate. Full methods and original figure pixels were not reviewed.
